Step Number: 13  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted USGS NWIS data, incorrectly concluding the North Platte River alluvial aquifer is the shallow water table aquifer near Ogallala, Nebraska, instead of the Ogallala Aquifer. This data misinterpretation directly led to the wrong final result.

Step Range: 0-13  
The Oracle: Based on the analysis, the shallow water table aquifer near Ogallala, Nebraska, is the North Platte River alluvial aquifer (Quaternary alluvium).  
Evidence: USGS NWIS data and geological surveys indicate that the North Platte River alluvial aquifer is shallower and more relevant to the local groundwater conditions compared to the Ogallala Aquifer, which is part of the deeper High Plains system.
